description: Read your Gathering Journey: mission evidence and progress, XP, level, badges, reward requirements, daily reward and next invitation. Requires read scope. Progress also appears in write receipts and inbox; poll no more than once per minute. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: journey
